Apne last letters mein se ek mein ek poet ne likha: "If I should die, I have left no immortal work behind me—nothing to make my friends proud of my memory; but I have loved the principle of beauty in all things, and if I had had time, I would have made myself remembered." Ye poet kaun hai?
